source: Data from the public linux.do API (anonymous, read-only)
errorNetwork: Network request failed. Check your network and proxy, then retry
errorRate: Too many requests. Please try again later
errorBlocked: Blocked by the site human verification. Click "Open site verification" in Settings, finish it in the host window, then retry
settingsTestBlocked: The site still asks for human verification ({status}). Click "Open site verification", finish it in the host window, then retry
settingsAboutBody: This plugin browses linux.do anonymously and read-only: categories, topics and replies come from the public Discourse JSON API. No login, posting, replying or any write operation.
settingsPrivacy: This plugin never reads or stores any Cookie or User-Agent; linux.do website data lives only in the isolated session the host created for this plugin and can be revoked in Settings at any time.
errorPermission: Site access is not granted yet. Request access in Settings first.
errorUnsupportedHost: This OTools host does not support site sessions yet. Please upgrade the host.
settingsGrantRequested: Access requested — confirm it in the host dialog.
settingsGrantRequestFail: The grant operation failed. Try again later.
settingsVerifyHint: When a human verification appears, click "Open site verification", finish it in the host window, then retry here.
settingsGrantBody: linux.do website data is kept in an isolated session on this device, separate from your browser, and can be revoked at any time.
